items.headline: ESAs call for vigilance over external dependencies, cyber threats and private credit risks
items.summary: ESAs call for vigilance over external dependencies, cyber threats and private credit risks 23 September 2026 Joint Committee Risk monitoring The European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) have identified external dependencies, emerging technologies and private credit as key vulnerabilities for the EU financial system in their Autumn 2026 risk update.
